Class CashierPage

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.awt.Component
      • java.awt.Container

  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.awt.image.ImageObserver, java.awt.MenuContainer, java.io.Serializable, javax.accessibility.Accessible
    class CashierPage
extends javax.swing.JPanel
    Represents the Cashier page in the Point of Sale system. Handles order entry, item selection, customization, and submission.
